title: SQL FCI failover: Move-ClusterGroup between nodes
description: The nexus-cli failover-test verb for the SQL Server FCI: Move-ClusterGroup the SQL Server role to the passive node, poll until the FCI virtual server answers, measure RTO, then move back.

observe.what: original primary -> new primary + the RTO timeline (pre-flight, failure injected, new primary observed, recovered)
the SQL Server (MSSQLSERVER) role moves to the other node then back

whatProves: WSFC fails the single FCI instance between sql-fci-1/2 over the shared iSCSI LUN; the FCI virtual server sqlfci @ .16 follows the active node (RTO ~4.5 s).
